# dbt Developer Hub

> > Official documentation for dbt (data build tool), covering analytics engineering, the Semantic Layer with MetricFlow, dbt Mesh, and best practices for data transformation workflows.

The dbt Developer Hub provides comprehensive guides for building scalable data transformation projects using SQL, Python, and Jinja templating. It covers core concepts like semantic models, metrics definition, multi-project collaboration with dbt Mesh, and enterprise patterns for organizing marts and data models.

## Key Topics

- dbt (data build tool)
- Semantic Layer
- MetricFlow
- dbt Mesh
- Analytics Engineering
- Semantic Models
- Metrics Definition
- Data Modeling
- Materializations (tables, views, incremental)
- YAML Configuration
- Jinja Templating
- dbt CLI
- Marts (business entities)
- Model Contracts
- Normalization and Denormalization

## Semantic Layer and Metrics

- [Intro to the dbt Semantic Layer](https://docs.getdbt.com/best-practices/how-we-build-our-metrics/semantic-layer-1-intro): Introduction to dbt Semantic Layer with MetricFlow for metrics definition
- [Set up the dbt Semantic Layer](https://docs.getdbt.com/best-practices/how-we-build-our-metrics/semantic-layer-2-setup): Setup guide for dbt Semantic Layer using dbt CLI and MetricFlow commands
- [Building semantic models](https://docs.getdbt.com/best-practices/how-we-build-our-metrics/semantic-layer-3-build-semantic-models): Build semantic models with YAML for entities, dimensions, and measures
- [Building metrics](https://docs.getdbt.com/best-practices/how-we-build-our-metrics/semantic-layer-4-build-metrics): Define and build metrics in YAML using dbt Semantic Layer
- [More advanced metrics](https://docs.getdbt.com/best-practices/how-we-build-our-metrics/semantic-layer-5-advanced-metrics): Create advanced metrics: ratio, derived, and cumulative types
- [Tactical terminology](https://docs.getdbt.com/best-practices/how-we-build-our-metrics/semantic-layer-6-terminology): Semantic Layer terminology: normalization, denormalization, marts, and OBT

## dbt Mesh and Multi-Project Collaboration

- [Intro to dbt Mesh](https://docs.getdbt.com/best-practices/how-we-mesh/mesh-1-intro): Introduction to dbt Mesh for multi-project and cross-project references
- [Who is dbt Mesh for?](https://docs.getdbt.com/best-practices/how-we-mesh/mesh-2-who-is-dbt-mesh-for): Determine if dbt Mesh fits your team's organizational structure
- [Coordinating model versions](https://docs.getdbt.com/best-practices/how-we-mesh/mesh-6-coordinate-versions): Coordinate producer-consumer workflows for dbt Mesh model versioning

## Project Structure and Data Modeling

- [Marts: Business-defined entities](https://docs.getdbt.com/best-practices/how-we-structure/4-marts): Structure marts layer with denormalization or Semantic Layer normalization
- [The rest of the project](https://docs.getdbt.com/best-practices/how-we-structure/5-the-rest-of-the-project): Organize dbt project files: YAML configs, models, and folder structure
- [Materializations best practices](https://docs.getdbt.com/best-practices/materializations/1-guide-overview): Overview of dbt materializations: tables, views, and incremental models

## Code Style and Formatting

- [How we style our Python](https://docs.getdbt.com/best-practices/how-we-style/3-how-we-style-our-python): Python style guide using black formatter and ruff linter for dbt models
- [How we style our Jinja](https://docs.getdbt.com/best-practices/how-we-style/4-how-we-style-our-jinja): Jinja templating style guide for dbt macros and whitespace control
- [How we style our YAML](https://docs.getdbt.com/best-practices/how-we-style/5-how-we-style-our-yaml): YAML formatting best practices using Prettier and dbt JSON schema
- [Don't nest your curlies](https://docs.getdbt.com/best-practices/dont-nest-your-curlies): Avoid nesting Jinja curly brackets in dbt templates and macros

## Platform Integration

- [Best practices for dbt and Unity Catalog](https://docs.getdbt.com/best-practices/dbt-unity-catalog-best-practices): Configure dbt with Databricks Unity Catalog and Hive metastore integration

## Optional

- [Best practices conclusion](https://docs.getdbt.com/best-practices/how-we-build-our-metrics/semantic-layer-9-conclusion): Semantic Layer and MetricFlow best practices conclusion
- [Now it's your turn](https://docs.getdbt.com/best-practices/how-we-style/6-how-we-style-conclusion): Style guide conclusion with pre-commit hooks and project evaluator tips
